full_name: Christopher Harris | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Arts Radcliffe-Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow University of Iowa
bio: Christopher Harris is an associate professor of film and video production in the Department of Cinematic Arts at the University of Iowa. He makes films and video installations that read African American historiography through the poetics and aesthetics of experimental cinema.
